text:
alex_sales: FYI Helio Financial dropped a POC request + security questionnaire. Main asks: Okta SAML + SCIM for ~50k users, group-to-role RBAC, domain ownership proofing (DNS preferred), soft-delete retention, and quote for a short Dedicated trial. Can @priya_se and @lucas_security pick up triage?
priya_se: On it. Quick clarifying qs: do they want delegated admin accounts provisioned via SCIM? And which NameID format do they expect?
alex_sales: They want a small set of delegated admins (scoped), NameID=email, and DNS TXT for domain proofing. Also asking for SAML session lifetimes up to 12h for overnight processes.
julie_solution_eng: We support Okta SAML (metadata import, RSA-SHA256) and SCIM v2 with PATCH and bulk endpoints. RBAC works by mapping Okta groups -> Redwood roles; we don't auto-promote by default. Example SAML metadata snippet for their IdP:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-internal.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
priya_se: I'll send mapping recommendations: NameID=email, attributes: email, firstName, lastName, groups. For SCIM: preferred attributes: externalId, employeeNumber, manager, title. Ask them to include groups in SCIM if they want real-time RBAC sync.
lucas_security: Compliance notes: we can provide SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001. Support EU data residency and BYOK. For deletion semantics we support tombstone + configurable retention (default 90 days). We'll need an addendum for retention and eDiscovery.
alex_sales: Pricing ask: they want a 3-month Dedicated trial then 12-month commit. Load estimate: 4k auth checks/sec steady, bursts to 8k. Any sizing notes?
julie_solution_eng: Rough sizing: likely 2 GPU-equivalent for steady; recommend burst credits or autoscale to 4-equivalent for peaks. I'll loop in finance for a precise estimate. Ballpark: low-to-mid five figures monthly for steady capacity, with additional burst charges.
priya_se: Operational caveat on long SAML sessions: we can extend to 24h per-RP but that's flagged by security. Recommend refresh tokens for programmatic jobs where possible.
lucas_security: Also confirm SAML assertions are encrypted and signatures use RSA-SHA256. We'll provide sample config and a checklist for their security questionnaire answers.
infra-bot: ticket-bot: created ticket POC-673 (Helio SCIM ingest test) assigned to @julie_solution_eng, due in 4 business days.
julie_solution_eng: I'll prep an Okta app template, SCIM bulk payload examples, and a DNS TXT proofing guide. Example SCIM bulk `curl` for initial sync:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Bulk" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"Operations": [{"method":"POST","path":"/Users","data":{...}}]}'
```
alex_sales: I'll upload Helio's questionnaire to POC-673 and schedule a kickoff call. Who can join tomorrow 9am PT?
priya_se: I can. Add me and include the Okta metadata they'll try.
lucas_security: I'll join to run through the compliance answers and bring SOC2 docs. Please ask Helio to share a sample SCIM CSV/export so we can size the ingest job.
julie_solution_eng: Confirmed 14 I'll have the checklist + sample mappings by EOD.
alex_sales: Great, thanks all. Next: attach certs to ticket, send placeholder pricing, request SCIM export, and confirm kickoff attendees.
